summary.tldr: Creates a federal tuition payment for some students with disabilities and makes the payment tax-free.
what_it_does: Requires the minister to pay tuition fees directly to a designated educational institution for a person who qualifies under section 118.3 of the Income Tax Act and is enrolled there, subject to set conditions.
Treats tuition paid under this new rule as a grant to the student.
Lets regulations set the conditions that must be met before the payment can be made.
Excludes amounts paid under this rule from income under the Income Tax Act.
who_it_affects: Students who qualify for the disability tax credit
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Student Financial Assistance Act and the Income Tax Act.
